body:
Founder real-time direct follow-up: 'now we need gpg key generation same thing.' New internal/gpgkey shells out to the real, already-installed gpg binary (RSA 4096, sign-capable) into a self-contained keyring, never the caller's default ~/.gnupg. showDeviceGpgKey runs right after showDeviceKey in the login sequence, printing the real armored public key block -- private material never leaves the device. New reflux.ActionGpgKeyReady. Desktop-only (no gpg on Android), named not hidden. Real, live, passing test against the actual gpg binary. Commit a87bca2, pushed.

⚓ ☃
title: Device GPG key generation, same in-app affordance as SSH
